provenance.method: Finite-chain exact marginalization with constants and conditional observables; isolated-star full Walsh expansion; analytic solutions of the stated one-loop O(n) truncation.

chain.scope: Exact finite periodic chain, positive-direction bonds with multiplicity; physical lattice spacing doubles. Separate 40-step correlation-length reference assumes h=0 and an infinite chain, regardless of field control.

star.scope: One isolated four-arm star, no external-spin field or outer bonds. Full Walsh expansion exact; order>2 coefficients discarded only in the explicitly renormalized pair approximation. Not an exact whole-square-lattice RG.

crossing.scope: Threshold |t|=1 in the truncated flow; not a certified physical correlation length.

flow.scope: Exact solution of explicitly truncated one-loop O(n) RG equations in local thermal scaling coordinates; ell increases toward IR. Epsilon-series exponents known only through O(epsilon); eta omitted is O(epsilon^2). The reciprocal of a truncated eigenvalue contains uncontrolled higher orders. Smallness flags are diagnostics, not error bounds.

data.scope: Finite periodic-chain decimation with absolute partition constants and transformed observables; exact isolated-star marginal and Walsh expansion; explicit pair truncation; exact analytic solutions of a stated one-loop O(n) truncation. No claim of an exact two-dimensional RG or certified three-dimensional critical exponents.
